compilationObservableClaim: For an opted-in compilation, a syntax tree that uses the exact Program Kit generated-source ownership header is under the exact ProgramKitGenerated/<intent>/<file>.cs logical path, and a tree under that path has the exact ownership header.
claimsOutsideRule: Generator identity, ownership transfer, manifest selection, exact source inventory, and physical-source forgery resistance are gate-mechanics claims and are not established by PKCC001.
Program Kit repository layout, namespace, warning-ledger, behavior, and private generated-source policy remain PKCS-owned and are not established by PKCC001.
